references.relationship: §364 tolls §340.5. The two provisions are operationally inseparable — every §364 notice decision is also a §340.5 calendar decision.
§364 cross-references Civ §3333.2(e)(2) for the definition of 'health care provider'. The two provisions use the same definitional framework.
SIRVA state-court claims must comply with §364 before filing. The steward's SIRVA case is the primary operational binding for this standard.
